name: Ultimate Dirk Strider
source:
The version of Dirk Strider from the Meat timeline. His goal is to ensure that Earth-C continues to remain relevant, and thus "canon," by casting himself as a villain so that a coherent narrative can continue.

He is an Ultimate Self, an amalgamation of every version of Dirk from across paradox space.
